paragraphs: When used in this report, the terms "the Company," "our Company," "Primo Brands," "we," "us," or "our" refers to Primo Brands Corporation, together with its consolidated subsidiaries, for periods following the Transaction (as defined below) and to Triton Water Parent, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries (collectively, "BlueTriton") and/or Primo Water Corporation and its consolidated subsidiaries (collectively, "Primo Water") for periods prior to the Transaction.

Primo Brands is a leading North American branded beverage company focused on healthy hydration, delivering responsibly sourced diversified offerings across products, formats, channels, price points and consumer occasions, distributed in every U.S. state and Canada. We were organized as a Delaware corporation in 2024, initially under the name Triton US HoldCo, Inc. On November 8, 2024, Triton US HoldCo, Inc. completed a series of merger transactions involving BlueTriton and Primo Water, pursuant to which Primo Water and BlueTriton became wholly owned subsidiaries of Triton US Holdco, Inc. (including all related transactions, the "Transaction"). Triton US Holdco, Inc. was subsequently renamed Primo Brands Corporation. The Company became the successor issuer to Primo Water pursuant to Rule 12g-3(a) under the Exchange Act. Pursuant to Rule 12g-3(e) under the Exchange Act, our Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the "Class A common stock") was deemed to be registered under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act, and the Company is subject to the informational requirements of the Exchange Act and the related rules and regulations. On November 11, 2024, the Company's Class A common stock began regular-way trading on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the ticker symbol "PRMB".

We have a comprehensive portfolio of highly recognizable and conveniently packaged branded water and beverages that reach consumers whenever, wherever, and however they hydrate through distribution across retail outlets, away from home, such as hotels and hospitals, and hospitality and food service accounts, as well as direct delivery to homes and businesses. These brands include established "billion-dollar brands" Poland Spring® and Pure Life®, premium brands like Saratoga® and The Mountain Valley®, leading regional spring water offerings such as Arrowhead®, Deer Park®, Ice Mountain®, Ozarka®, and Zephyrhills®, purified water brands including Primo Water® and Sparkletts®, and flavored and enhanced beverages like Splash Refresher™ and AC+ION®. Primo Brands also has an industry-leading line-up of innovative water dispensers, which create consumer connectivity through recurring water purchases. Primo Brands operates a vertically integrated coast-to-coast network that distributes its brands to more than 200,000 retail outlets, as well as directly reaching customers and consumers through its Direct Delivery, Exchange and Refill offerings. Through Direct Delivery, Primo Brands delivers responsibly sourced hydration solutions direct to home and business customers. Through its Exchange business, consumers can visit approximately 26,500 retail locations and purchase a pre-filled, multi-use bottle of water that can be exchanged after use for a discount on the next purchase. Through its Refill business, consumers have the option to refill empty multi-use bottles at over 23,500 self-service refill stations. Primo Brands also offers water filtration units for home and business customers across North America. Primo Brands is a leader in reusable beverage packaging, helping to reduce waste through its multi-serve bottles and innovative brand packaging portfolio, which includes recycled plastic, aluminum, and glass. Primo Brands has a portfolio of over 80 springs and actively manages water resources to help assure a steady supply of quality, safe drinking water today and in the future. Primo Brands also helps conserve over 28,000 acres of land across the U.S. and Canada. Primo Brands is proud to partner with the International Bottled Water Association ("IBWA") in North America, which supports strict adherence to safety, quality, sanitation, and regulatory standards for the benefit of consumer protection. Primo Brands is committed to supporting the communities it serves, investing in local and national programs and delivering hydration solutions following natural disasters and other local community challenges. Primo Brands employs more than 12,000 associates with dual headquarters in Tampa, Florida, and Stamford, Connecticut.

Prior to the Transaction, Primo Water divested a portion of its European business and our remaining international businesses at the time of the Transaction included Decantae Mineral Water Limited, Fonthill Waters Ltd, and portions of the Eden Springs Netherlands B.V. business located in Israel and the United Kingdom (collectively the "Remaining International Businesses"). On November 25, 2024, we sold our interests in the Decantae Mineral Water Limited and Fonthill Waters Limited businesses. On April 11, 2025, we sold our interests in the Eden Springs Netherlands B.V. business located in the United Kingdom and, on October 23, 2025, we sold our interests in the Eden Springs Netherlands B.V. business located in Israel. Following completion of these sales, we no longer have operations outside of North America. Results attributable to the Remaining International Businesses are collectively presented herein as discontinued operations in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America ("U.S. GAAP"). Unless otherwise noted, discussion within Part I and Part II relates to continuing operations.

We operate within the large and growing U.S. beverage industry, a $150+ billion market based on 2025 retail sales. The beverage industry encompasses a broad range of non-alcoholic beverage categories such as bottled water, soft drinks, energy

drinks, juices, ready-to-drink coffee and tea, sports drinks, sparkling juices, coconut water, plant-based water, ciders, smoothies and kombucha. As consumer preferences increasingly shift toward healthier, sustainable and functional options, the beverage industry is undergoing significant transformation and growth.

Within this evolving landscape, we serve the attractive bottled water sub-category of beverage, one of the largest and responsibly growing categories. In 2025, the U.S. bottled water market, which includes still water, sparkling water and seltzer water, generated $30 billion in retail sales. Bottled water has continued to be the beverage of choice in the U.S., ranking as the number one beverage by volume for nine consecutive years.

We distribute conveniently packaged branded beverages to retail outlets and provide bottled water solutions and water filtration services through direct-to-consumer offerings in North America. Our products consist primarily of premium spring and sparkling water, purified water, self-service refill drinking water, flavored and enhanced beverages, water dispensers, and filtration equipment.

We believe Primo Brands is uniquely positioned as a leader in the healthy hydration category, driven by the strength of our iconic brands with rich heritage. Our portfolio, led by established billion-dollar brands, Poland Spring® and Pure Life®, also includes our premium brands, Saratoga and The Mountain Valley® and other nationally recognized regional spring and purified brands. We maintain a diverse portfolio that serves multiple consumer usage occasions across a wide spectrum of formats and price points. With our expanding scale and resources, we are accelerating the growth of other brands within our portfolio and leveraging our nationwide footprint.

We are the category leader in U.S. bottled water, holding the number one market share in the retail channel, supported by our nationally recognized, fast-growing brands. A majority of our core brands have demonstrated strong, volume-driven growth in recent years.

We believe our differentiated, vertically integrated distribution network spanning coast-to-coast provides us with benefits that are difficult to replicate, including lower cost to serve and increased control over our supply chain and product quality. We also believe that our scaled national platform and go-to-market strategy amplify our brand reach and circular packaging strategy. Our distribution network spans multiple channels, formats and geographies, including every U.S. state and Canada, providing us with exceptional consumer access across North America. Our world-class operational capabilities are supported by an extensive infrastructure that includes more than 50 production facilities, more than 200 depots, and a robust returnable packaging operation. In addition, our direct-to-consumer network is underpinned by a delivery fleet of approximately 4,800 vehicles. We have more than 80 spring water sources in our portfolio located across North America. Redundancy across multiple spring sources reduces supply risk by avoiding dependency on a single supply point. To preserve this long-term flexibility, we continually identify, evaluate and permit additional springs so that redundancy remains central to our water security strategy. This strategy strengthens our profitability and helps us further support our sustainability and water stewardship efforts. Of the more than 80 spring water sources in our portfolio located across the U.S. and Canada, 36 sites are Company-owned while the remaining are utilized through a variety of contracts. The bulk of the Company's spring sources are located in Maine, Pennsylvania, California, Florida, and Texas.

In recent years, we have implemented several initiatives, such as active SKU management processes, to drive operational efficiencies across our manufacturing and distribution network. Our differentiated logistics model enables us to deliver water efficiently from the spring source directly to customers, supporting reliability and quality. The optimization of our complete footprint across our manufacturing locations, routes and branches remains in focus.

Primo Brands combines its iconic brand portfolio with a scaled national platform to provide consumers with healthy hydration whenever and wherever they hydrate. Primo Brands' diversified, omni-channel business model offers exceptional access to its consumers and a differentiated ability to serve multiple consumer usage occasions and price points. Our broad and vertically integrated manufacturing and distribution footprint across North America supports strong recurring revenues from our Direct Delivery, Exchange, Refill and Filtration offerings.

Our strong retail and direct-to-consumer footprint creates a multiplier effect, enabling us to serve many usage occasions and fulfill the growing demand for consumers' desire for convenience and sustainability. Our product portfolio spans across all dayparts, providing customers with healthy hydration at-home, at-work and on-the-go. We continuously invest in brand innovation, as well as our circular packaging infrastructure (delivery, exchange, refill and filtration service), call centers and technology capabilities to ensure that we remain a go-to provider of healthy hydration solutions across products, formats, channels and price points.

paragraphs: In addition to the other information set forth in this Annual Report, you should carefully consider the following factors, which could materially affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. The risks described below are not the only risks that we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial also may negatively affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.
The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results:
•our future results may suffer if we do not effectively manage our expanded operations; •we face significant competition in the segment in which we operate;
•our success depends, in part, on our intellectual property, which we may be unable to maintain and protect;
•we may not be able to consummate acquisitions, or acquisitions may be difficult to integrate, and we may not realize the expected revenue and cost synergies related to each such acquisition;

•our business is dependent on our ability to maintain access to our water sources. Water scarcity, government regulation of water access, loss of water rights, and poor quality could negatively affect our long-term financial performance;

paragraphs: The following discussion provides an analysis of the Company's financial condition, cash flows and results of operations from management's perspective and should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8 "Financial Statements And Supplementary Data" of this Annual Report. Our objective is to also provide discussion of events and uncertainties known to management that are reasonably likely to cause reported financial information not to be indicative of future operating results or of future financial condition and to offer information that provides understanding of our financial condition, cash flows and results of operations.

This section generally discusses the results of our operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. For a discussion of the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, please refer to Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 27, 2025.

We believe we are well-positioned to benefit from evolving consumer trends, as well as the continued acceleration of e-commerce. These favorable trends, combined with the broad appeal of our brands, provide us with a significant opportunity to drive the growth of our business.

•Ability to Increase Brand Awareness – Our ability to increase brand awareness has and will continue to contribute meaningfully to our performance. We focus on creating, capturing and retaining new demand by increasing our brand awareness while also increasing our value proposition to our customers. We aim to continue to increase our brand awareness through continued local community engagement, national media campaigns, growing our social community and innovating our packaging to make our brands and products visually appealing and distinctive from other bottled water brands.

•Product Innovation and Expansion – We see significant potential to grow our sales in underpenetrated, high-growth segments of the bottled water category, such as sparkling, flavored and enhanced waters, by leveraging the brand equity of our existing brands to develop new and innovative beverage offerings. Through the flexible production capabilities of our existing infrastructure and our extensive distribution and retail relationships, we believe we will be able to quickly develop, produce and commercialize new products. We intend to continue investing in innovations within our product portfolio, as well as the development and introduction of new products.

•E-commerce – Given the trend towards growth of sales through e-commerce websites and mobile commerce applications, including through subscription services and other direct-to-consumer businesses, the consumer is leveraging multiple methods of engagement including the digital marketplace.

Our industry has been affected by the trend toward consolidation in the retail channel. Many of our retail customers have consolidated in recent years, and this consolidation trend may continue. As a result, our retail customers may seek lower pricing and demand increased marketing or promotional expenditures from us. Large retailers are also increasingly using their distribution networks and economies of scale to introduce and develop private-label brands, such as those carried by supermarket chains, convenience store chains, drug store chains, mass merchants and club warehouses. See Item 1A. "Risk Factors — Risks Related to our Customers, Suppliers and Associates" in this Annual Report.

Our operations and supplier relationships expose us to risks associated with disruptions to global supply chains and tariffs, which are likely to continue to create challenging conditions for our business through increased costs, lower consumer spending, volatility in financial markets and other impacts. While we have taken steps to minimize these impacts, global supply chain disruption may deteriorate, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

The markets in which we operate are subject to seasonal variations. Our water sales are generally higher during the warmer months and our purchases of raw materials and related accounts payable fluctuate based upon the demand for our products. This seasonality causes our working capital needs to fluctuate throughout the year.

We conduct operations in Canada and are subject to currency exchange risks to the extent that our costs are denominated in currencies other than those in which we earn revenues. As our financial statements are denominated in U.S. dollars, fluctuations in currency exchange rates between the U.S. dollar and the Canadian dollar have had, and will continue to have, an impact on our results of operations.

Ingredient and packaging costs represent a significant portion of our cost of sales. These costs are subject to global and regional commodity price trends. Our most significant commodities are PET resin, glass, aluminum, HDPE and LDPE. We attempt to manage our exposure to fluctuations in ingredient and packaging costs by entering into fixed price commitments for a portion of our ingredient and packaging requirements and implementing price increases as needed.

In 2025, our capital expenditures were devoted primarily to supporting growth in our business, maintaining existing facilities, making equipment upgrades and post-Transaction (as defined below) integration related activities.

paragraphs: 於本報告中，"the Company"、"our Company"、"Primo Brands"、"we"、"us" 或 "our" 係指 Primo Brands Corporation，包含其合併子公司，自 Transaction（如下所定義）後之期間，以及 Triton Water Parent, Inc. 及其合併子公司（合稱 "BlueTriton"）及/或 Primo Water Corporation 及其合併子公司（合稱 "Primo Water"）自 Transaction 前之期間。

Primo Brands 是北美領先的知名品牌飲料公司，專注於健康補水，提供負責任來源的多元化產品，涵蓋產品類型、格式、通路、價格點及消費者場合，於美國各州及加拿大皆有分銷。我們於 2024 年成立為德拉瓦州公司，最初名稱為 Triton US HoldCo, Inc. 2024 年 11 月 8 日，Triton US HoldCo, Inc. 完成一連串涉及 BlueTriton 及 Primo Water 的合併交易，根據此交易，Primo Water 及 BlueTriton 成為 Triton US Holdco, Inc. 的 wholly owned 子公司（包括所有相關交易，稱為 "Transaction"）。Triton US Holdco, Inc. 隨後更名為 Primo Brands Corporation。本公司成為 Primo Water 的繼承發行者，根據證券交易法第 12g-3(a) 條。根據證券交易法第 12g-3(e) 條，本公司 Class A 普通股（每股票面價值 $0.01，稱為 "Class A 普通股"）被視為已註冊於證券交易法第 12(b) 條，本公司需遵守證券交易法及其相關規則與規範。2024 年 11 月 11 日，本公司 Class A 普通股開始在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）以 "PRMB" 為股票代碼進行普通交易。

我們擁有廣泛的高知名度且方便包裝的品牌水與飲料，可於消費者隨時、隨地、以任何方式補水，透過零售通路、離家場所（如飯店與醫院）以及餐飲與食品服務帳戶進行分銷，並直接送達家庭與企業。這些品牌包括已建立的 "十億美元品牌" Poland Spring® 和 Pure Life®，高階品牌如 Saratoga® 和 The Mountain Valley®，領導性的區域天然水品牌如 Arrowhead®、Deer Park®、Ice Mountain®、Ozarka® 和 Zephyrhills®，淨化水品牌包括 Primo Water® 和 Sparkletts®，以及風味與增強型飲料如 Splash Refresher™ 和 AC+ION®。Primo Brands 還擁有行業領先的創新水 dispenser 系列，透過持續的水購買建立消費者連接。Primo Brands 操作一個垂直整合的跨國網路，將其品牌分銷至超過 200,000 個零售點，並透過其 Direct Delivery、Exchange 和 Refill 服務直接觸及消費者。透過 Direct Delivery，Primo Brands 將負責任來源的補水解決方案直接送達家庭與企業客戶。透過其 Exchange 服務，消費者可造訪約 26,500 個零售點，購買預裝填、多用途的水瓶，使用後可換取下次購買的折扣。透過其 Refill 服務，消費者可選擇在超過 23,500 個自助 refill 站點 refill 空的多用途水瓶。Primo Brands 還提供家用與企業用的水過濾單元。Primo Brands 是可重複使用飲料包裝的領導者，透過其多用途瓶與創新品牌包裝組合，幫助減少廢棄物，包含回收塑膠、鋁與玻璃。Primo Brands 擁有超過 80 個泉源，並積極管理水資源，以確保未來持續穩定的高品質安全飲用水。Primo Brands 還協助保護美國與加拿大超過 28,000 英畝的.land。Primo Brands 自豪與國際瓶裝水協會（"IBWA"）在北美合作，支持嚴格遵守安全、品質、衛生與規範標準，以保護消費者權益。Primo Brands 承諾支持其服務的社區，投資於本地與國家計畫，並在自然災害及其他社區挑戰後提供補水解決方案。Primo Brands 僱用超過 12,000 名員工，雙總部位於佛羅裏達州坦帕與康乃狄克州史丹福。

在 Transaction 之前，Primo Water 已出售其部分歐洲業務，而我們在 Transaction 時的剩餘國際業務包括 Decantae Mineral Water Limited、Fonthill Waters Ltd，以及位於以色列與英國的 Eden Springs Netherlands B.V. 業務部分（合稱 "Remaining International Businesses"）。2024 年 11 月 25 日，我們出售了 Decantae Mineral Water Limited 與 Fonthill Waters Limited 的業務。2025 年 4 月 11 日，我們出售了位於英國的 Eden Springs Netherlands B.V. 業務，2025 年 10 月 23 日，我們出售了位於以色列的 Eden Springs Netherlands B.V. 業務。完成這些出售後，我們不再在北美以外有業務。屬於 Remaining International Businesses 的結果在此以停業業務（discontinued operations）呈現，符合美國通用會計準則（"U.S. GAAP"）。除非另有說明，Part I 與 Part II 的討論均與持續業務（continuing operations）相關。
我們經營於美國規模龐大且持續成長的飲料產業，根據2025年零售銷售額計算，該產業市場規模達1500億美元以上。飲料產業涵蓋廣泛的非酒精飲料類別，例如瓶裝水、碳酸飲料、能量飲料、果汁、即飲咖啡與茶、運動飲料、氣泡果汁、椰子水、植物基水、蘋果汁、冰沙與康普茶。
在這個不斷變化的產業環境中，我們服務於飲料產業中具吸引力的瓶裝水子類別，這是其中規模最大且持續健康成長的類別之一。根據2025年零售銷售額計算，美國瓶裝水市場（包括靜態水、氣泡水與氣泡蘇打水）產生了300億美元的銷售額。瓶裝水持續為美國消費者最常選擇的飲料，根據體積銷售量，已連續九年位居飲料銷售冠軍。
我們將方便包裝的自有品牌飲料分銷至零售通路，並透過直接對消費者方案提供瓶裝水解決方案與水過濾服務，服務範圍為北美地區。我們的產品主要為高階天然泉與氣泡水、純淨水、自取式 refill 飲用水、調味與增強型飲料、水 dispenser 與過濾設備。
我們的產品主要為高階天然泉與氣泡水、純淨水、自取式 refill 飲用水、調味與增強型飲料、水 dispenser 與過濾設備。

本公司認為 Primo Brands 在健康補水類別中擁有獨特的優勢，這得益於我們標誌性的品牌所具備的豐富歷史與強大聲譽。我們的產品組合以已建立的十億美元品牌 Poland Spring® 和 Pure Life® 為主導，也包含我們的高階品牌 Saratoga 和 The Mountain Valley®，以及其他 nationally recognized 的區域天然水與純淨水品牌。我們維持一個多樣化的產品組合，服務多種消費者使用情境，涵蓋廣泛的產品形式與價格層級。隨著我們擴張規模與資源，我們正在加速成長其他品牌，並善用我們全國性的據點。
我們是美國瓶裝水類別的領導者，擁有零售通路的第一市場佔有率，這得益於我們 nationally recognized 且快速成長的品牌。我們大多數核心品牌在近年已展現強勁的體積驅動成長。

本公司認為我們差異化的垂直整合配送網路橫跨全美，為我們帶來難以複製的優勢，包括較低的服務成本與對供應鏈與產品品質的更大控制力。我們也認為我們規模化的全國平台與市場推廣策略，能擴大我們的品牌觸及範圍與循環包裝策略。我們的配送網路涵蓋多種通路、產品形式與地理區域，包括美國所有州與加拿大，為我們帶來北美洲的卓越消費者接觸機會。我們的世界級運營能力由廣泛的基礎設施支撐，包括超過 50 個生產廠房、超過 200 個倉庫，以及強大的可回運包裝作業。此外，我們的直銷消費者網路由約 4,800 輛運輸車輛組成。我們的產品組閤中擁有超過 80 個天然水來源，分佈於北美洲各地。多樣化的天然水來源可降低供應風險，避免對單一供應點的依賴。為維持這種長期靈活性，我們持續識別、評估並取得新的水源，使冗餘成為我們水資源安全策略的核心。此策略強化我們的獲利能力，並協助我們進一步支持永續發展與水資源管理努力。在美國與加拿大超過 80 個天然水來源中，有 36 個為本公司所有，其餘則透過多種契約使用。本公司大多數天然水來源位於緬因州、賓州、加州、佛羅裏達州與德州。
近年來，我們已實施多項措施，例如主動的 SKU 管理流程，以提升我們製造與配送網路的運營效率。我們差異化的物流模式使我們能從天然水來源直接高效地將水送達客戶，支持可靠性與品質。我們持續優化製造廠點、路線與分支的整體佈局。

Primo Brands 結合其標誌性的品牌組合與規模化的全國平台，為消費者在任何時間、任何地點提供健康補水。Primo Brands 的多樣化、全通路商業模式為消費者提供卓越的接觸機會，並具備差異化的服務多種消費者使用情境與價格層級的能力。我們在北美洲廣泛且垂直整合的製造與配送佈局，支持我們 Direct Delivery、Exchange、Refill 與 Filtration 服務所帶來的強勁持續收入。
我們強大的零售與直銷消費者佈局產生乘數效應，使我們能服務多種使用情境，並滿足消費者對便利性與永續性的成長需求。我們的產品組合涵蓋全天候，為消費者在家中、工作地點與移動中提供健康補水。我們持續投資於品牌創新，以及循環包裝基礎設施（配送、交換、 refill 與過濾服務）、客服中心與科技能力，以確保我們成為健康補水解決方案的首選提供者，涵蓋產品、形式、通路與價格層級。

paragraphs: 以下討論提供從管理層觀點對本公司財務狀況、現金流及營運成果的分析，應配合本年報第二部分，第 8 項「財務報表與補充資料」所包含的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。我們的目標亦是提供管理層所知悉，合理可能導致報告財務資訊無法反映未來營運成果或財務狀況的事件與不確定性，並提供資訊以瞭解本公司財務狀況、現金流及營運成果。
本節一般討論本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度營運成果，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度比較。如需瞭解 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度與 2023 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度比較，請參閱本公司 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度 10-K 報告，該報告於 2025 年 2 月 27 日提交至證券交易委員會。
Primo Brands 是北美領先的自有品牌飲料公司，專注於健康補水，透過多樣化產品、形式、通路、價格點及消費者場合，提供負責任來源的飲料選擇，於美國各州及加拿大皆有分銷。

我們擁有廣泛且高度認知、方便包裝的自有品牌水與飲料產品，可於任何時間、任何地點、任何方式為消費者提供補水，透過零售通路、離家場所如飯店與醫院，以及餐飲與食品服務帳戶進行分銷，同時也直接送達家庭與企業。這些品牌包括已建立的 "十億美元品牌" Poland Spring® 和 Pure Life®，高階品牌如 Saratoga® 和 The Mountain Valley®，領導性的區域天然水品牌如 Arrowhead®、Deer Park®、Ice Mountain®、Ozarka® 和 Zephyrhills®，淨化水品牌包括 Primo Water® 和 Sparkletts®，以及風味與增強型飲料如 Splash Refresher™ 和 AC+ION®。我們也擁有業界領先的創新水 dispenser 系列，透過持續的水購買建立消費者連結。我們運營一個垂直整合的跨國分銷網路，將品牌分銷至超過 20 萬個零售點，同時透過 Direct Delivery、Exchange 和 Refill 服務直接接觸消費者與客戶。透過 Direct Delivery，我們將負責任來源的補水解決方案直接送達家庭與企業客戶。透過 Exchange 服務，消費者可造訪約 26,500 個零售點，購買預裝填、多用途的水瓶，使用後可換取下次購買的折扣。透過 Refill 服務，消費者可選擇在超過 23,500 個自助 refill 站點將空瓶 refill。我們也為北美地區的家庭與企業客戶提供水過濾設備。我們在可重複使用飲料包裝方面為領導者，透過多用途瓶與創新品牌包裝組合，協助減少廢棄物，該組合包括回收塑料、鋁與玻璃。我們擁有超過 80 個泉源，並積極管理水資源，以確保未來持續提供品質安全的飲用水。我們也協助保護美國與加拿大超過 28,000 英畝的土地。我們為北美的國際瓶裝水協會（"IBWA"）合作夥伴，支持嚴格遵守安全、品質、衛生與法規標準，以保護消費者權益。我們致力於支持所服務的社區，投資於地方與國家計畫，並在自然災害及其他地方社區挑戰時提供補水解決方案。我們僱用超過 12,000 名員工，雙總部設於佛羅裏達州坦帕與康乃狄克州史丹福。
我們認為本公司處於有利位置，可受益於消費者趨勢的演進，以及電商持續加速的發展。這些有利趨勢，加上我們品牌的廣泛吸引力，為我們提供顯著的機會來推動業務成長。
•提升品牌知名度的能力 – 我們提升品牌知名度的能力已並將持續對我們的表現做出重大貢獻。我們專注於創造、捕捉並保留新需求，同時提升品牌知名度與價值主張。我們旨在透過持續的地方社區參與、國家媒體活動、擴大社交社羣與創新包裝，使品牌與產品在視覺上更具吸引力與獨特性，與其他瓶裝水品牌區隔。
•產品創新與擴張 – 我們看到在瓶裝水類別中尚未充分開發、高成長的市場，如氣泡水、風味與增強型水，有顯著的銷售成長潛力，透過現有品牌的品牌價值，開發新穎的飲料產品。透過現有設施的靈活生產能力與廣泛的分銷與零售關係，我們相信能夠快速開發、生產與上市新產品。我們意圖持續投資於產品組合的創新，以及新產品的開發與推出。
•電商 – 考慮到透過電商網站與行動電商應用程式銷售成長的趨勢，包括透過訂閱服務與其他直接對消費者業務，消費者正利用多種方式參與，包括數位市場。

我產業受到零售通路趨向集中化的影響。許多我們的零售客戶近年來已經進行了集中化，這種集中化趨勢可能持續。因此，我們的零售客戶可能會要求較低的價格，並要求我們增加行銷或促銷支出。大型零售商也越來越利用其配送網路和規模經濟來推出和發展自有品牌，例如超市連鎖、便利商店連鎖、藥妝店連鎖、百貨商與俱樂部倉儲所銷售的品牌。請參閱本年度報告第 1A 項 "風險因素 — 與我們的客戶、供應商及合作夥伴相關的風險"。
我們的營運與供應商關係使我們面臨全球供應鏈中斷及關稅的風險，這些風險可能持續對我們的業務造成挑戰，包括成本增加、消費者支出減少、財務市場波動及其他影響。雖然我們已採取步驟來減輕這些影響，但全球供應鏈中斷情況可能惡化，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生不利影響。
我們所從事的市場受到季節性變動的影響。我們的水銷售額通常在較熱的月份較高，而我們的原材料採購及相關應付帳款則根據我們產品的需求而波動。這種季節性會導致我們的營運資金需求在一年內波動。
我們在加拿大進行營運，並因成本以除加拿大幣以外的貨幣計價，而面臨貨幣交換風險。由於我們的財務報表以美元計價，美元與加拿大幣之間的匯率波動已對我們的營運成果產生影響，並將持續產生影響。
原料及包裝成本佔我們銷售成本的很大一部分。這些成本受到全球及區域性商品價格趨勢的影響。我們最重要的商品為 PET 樹脂、玻璃、鋁、HDPE 及 LDPE。我們透過與部分原料及包裝需求訂立固定價格承諾，並在必要時實施價格調漲，來管理我們對原料及包裝成本波動的風險。
2025 年，我們的資本支出主要用於支撐業務成長、維護現有設施、進行設備升級及交易後（如後文所定義）的整合相關活動。

paragraphs: 除本年度報告中所載之其他資訊外，您應謹慎考量下列因素，這些因素可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生重大影響。下列所描述的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生負面影響。
下列為可能對本公司業務、營運及財務結果產生不利影響之主要風險摘要：
• 若本公司無法有效管理擴展後之業務，未來營運成果可能受影響；• 本公司所處之業務領域面臨激烈競爭；
• 本公司之成功在部分程度上取決於智慧財產權，而本公司可能無法維持並保護該智慧財產權；
• 本公司可能無法完成併購，或即使完成併購，亦可能難以整合，且可能無法實現與各項併購相關之預期營收與成本協同效益；
• 本公司業務依賴於維持對水資源之取用權。水資源短缺、政府對水資源取用之管制、水權喪失及水質不良等因素，可能對本公司長期財務表現產生負面影響；
